`install.py`의 TARGET/RESEARCH는 기존 사용자 요청에 따라 `C:/Users/USER/...`로 고정되어 있다. 새 컴퓨터의 사용자 이름이나 연구 경로가 다르면 **실행 전에** 두 경로와 TARGET 부모 검사 경로를 실제 위치로 수정한다. 기존 스킬이 있으면 설치기가 관리하지 않는 변경을 덮어쓰지 않는다. 연구를 이전하려면 최신 research-snapshots를 먼저 원하는 ResearchWorkspace에 복사한다. 기존 연구는 installer가 보존한다.

case_policy_findings.assessment: Past OCR failure evidence is mixed into a sound general caution. General rule may remain; historical proof belongs in validation records.
General cell-trace rule links a particular scan-table report as something to follow. Separate normative contract from historical validation provenance.
Specific prior parsing failures and report link in operational contract; not embedded PDF or full text. Can retain generic blocker rule and move case narrative to validation.
100.00 (548) mixed-unit example appears in general schema guidance. Treat as illustrative, never a default/source datum. Generic placeholder could reduce coupling.
Historical selected-region results, including quoted snippets and numeric findings; legitimate validation record but packaged under active skill references.
Historical exam OCR report with case-specific quotations and old local path; not a generic agent instruction or full PDF transcript.
Historical article/table selected-cell findings; legitimate provenance, not reusable general research evidence.

supporting_code_findings.assessment: Active CLI init default is literal C:/Users/USER/Documents/ResearchWorkspace.
Installer couples skill installation to pilot-kross-2013.
Guard also uses literal USER; changing target alone is insufficient.

Historical/domain evaluation tool, distinguish from general agent policy.

conclusion: No actual Markdown PDF image embed, HTML embed tag, PDF data URI or base64 signature was found in scanned Markdown. PDF URLs, filenames, historical selected quotations and findings exist. General policy has a hardcoded USER default and some case-derived narrative; detailed case reports reside in installed references because installer excludes validation directories but not reference reports. Vendor citation-guide links and historical research reports are legitimate references, not evidence of executable injection or fulltext contamination.
limitations: No full PDF prose-to-Markdown corpus comparison was performed; cannot guarantee absence of paraphrased or copied PDF prose.
Only filesystem Markdown scanned; Markdown inside ZIP/bundle archives not extracted.
Line numbers describe audit-time content; concurrent edits can make them stale.
No vendor, policy, code or historical research files changed.
recommendations: Keep historical reports and vendor intact; remove generic-policy dependency on case-specific results through references or migration records.
Use configurable current research root in general policy/CLI; keep pilot paths only in explicitly named fixtures/evaluations.
Separate PDF operational contract from selected-source historical reports; do not treat case data or pass counts as general guarantees.
